description: Brown & Brown, Inc., a Florida corporation, and its subsidiaries is a diversified insurance agency, wholesale brokerage, insurance programs and service organization that markets and sells insurance products and services, primarily in the property, casualty and employee benefits areas. It primarily operates as an agent or broker not assuming underwriting risks, while also operating and/or participating in various ancillary insurance operations, including reinsurance companies and stand-alone captives that assume underwriting risk, series captive insurance companies, protected cell companies, segregated account companies, a quota share captive and an excess of loss layer captive, which facilitate additional underwriting capacity, generate incremental revenues and/or enable it to participate in certain underwriting results. It also operates a write-your-own flood insurance carrier, Wright National.
